results.snippet: Turns numbers into notes in the scale (zero indexed). Also sets scale for other scale operations, like Pattern#scaleTranspose. A scale consists of a root note (e.g. c4, c, f#, bb4) followed by semicolon (':') and then a scale type. The root note defaults to octave 3, if no octave number is given.
